_doc: Markets opened automatically by open-markets.mjs at 00:00 UTC. cadence day = every day (closes next 00:00 UTC); week = Mondays (closes next Monday 00:00 UTC). thresholds: 'auto' cuts N buckets at quantiles of the metric's own hourly history once >= minWindows windows exist, else 'seed' is used; a single seed value makes a yes/no market. auto:false keeps the seed forever (small-integer metrics whose quantiles collapse). seedSkr = fee-free prize added from the operator wallet.

_retired: 2026-09-25: every review-count market (reviews_day/week, rev_week:<app>) retired. One verified Seeker may review each of the 1,300+ listed apps once, so a single device can move the store-wide count by hundreds in a day; the bettors are exactly the people who own Seekers. reviewers_7d (distinct devices) would be the honest version if a review market is ever wanted.
